newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates steady on Central Bank's cue.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates steady on Central Bank's cue.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were steady on Friday due to the holiday in New York and the Central Bank's unchanged overnight borrowing rate of 24 percent, traders said.
"Market has effectively said since the overnight rate was unchanged, the view hasn't really moved," a foreign bank dealer said. "Though there's pressure for rates to go up a little bit."
Dealers said they expected a big jump in T-bill rates at the auction on Monday, which would influence the swap market.
Thailand's de facto devaluation on Wednesday had forced domestic rates to rise to protect the peso.
